raw: [{"bbox": [84, 76, 581, 91], "category": "Page-header", "text": "KHANG DIEN HOUSE TRADING AND INVESTMENT JOINT STOCK COMPANY"}, {"bbox": [561, 100, 686, 114], "category": "Page-header", "text": "Form B 09 - DN/HN"}, {"bbox": [86, 133, 554, 149], "category": "Section-header", "text": "## 2 SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES (continued)"}, {"bbox": [84, 164, 342, 180], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.20 Revenue recognition (continued)"}, {"bbox": [84, 195, 382, 211], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### (d) Dividends, distributable profits income"}, {"bbox": [129, 227, 687, 260], "category": "Text", "text": "Income from dividends, distributable profits is recognised in the consolidated income statement when both (2) of the following conditions are satisfied:"}, {"bbox": [129, 276, 687, 308], "category": "List-item", "text": "- It is probable that economic benefits associated with the transaction will flow to the Company; and"}, {"bbox": [129, 309, 353, 324], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Income can be measured reliably."}, {"bbox": [129, 341, 687, 373], "category": "Text", "text": "Income from dividends, distributable profits is recognised when the Group has established receiving rights from investees."}, {"bbox": [84, 390, 242, 404], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.21 Sales deductions"}, {"bbox": [129, 422, 687, 469], "category": "Text", "text": "Sales deductions include trade discounts, sales returns and allowances. Sales deductions incurred in the same year of the related revenue from sales of products, goods and rendering of services are recorded as a deduction from the revenue of that year."}, {"bbox": [129, 486, 687, 534], "category": "Text", "text": "Sales deductions for sales of products, goods or rendering of services which are sold in the year but are incurred after the consolidated balance sheet date but before the issuance of the consolidated financial statements are recorded as a deduction from the revenue of the year."}, {"bbox": [84, 551, 403, 566], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.22 Cost of goods sold and services rendered"}, {"bbox": [129, 583, 687, 631], "category": "Text", "text": "Cost of goods sold and cost of services are the cost of finished goods, merchandises, materials sold or services rendered during the year and recorded on the basis of matching with revenue and on a prudent basis."}, {"bbox": [84, 648, 255, 664], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.23 Financial expenses"}, {"bbox": [129, 680, 687, 712], "category": "Text", "text": "Financial expenses are expenses incurred in the year for financial activities including interest expense; expenses of borrowing and bond issuance; and payment discounts."}, {"bbox": [84, 729, 241, 745], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.24 Selling expenses"}, {"bbox": [129, 761, 687, 793], "category": "Text", "text": "Selling expenses represent expenses that are incurred in process of selling products, goods and providing services."}, {"bbox": [84, 810, 372, 825], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.25 General and administration expenses"}, {"bbox": [129, 842, 687, 874], "category": "Text", "text": "General and administration expenses represent expenses that are incurred for administrative purposes."}, {"bbox": [380, 984, 395, 997], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "22"}]
